trustClaim.label: K3-TB trusted-boundary
trustClaim.summary: K3-TB trusted-boundary only; not fully formal K3 and not proven equivalent to Lean 4.

purpose: Machine-check the evidence required before a PSC-1 feature can be treated as production-supported.

supportedFeatureChecklist: Parser/syntax evidence when the source grammar changes.
Elaborator, checked bootstrap, or kernel evidence before execution.
Kernel obligation statement whenever trusted rules change; otherwise explicit no-new-kernel-rule claim.
JavaScript execution smoke for executable features.
TypeScript compile smoke for executable features.
Theorem/rfl/reduction smoke when the feature should reduce definitionally, or an explicit reason when not applicable.
Negative fail-closed smoke for invalid or unsafe source forms.
Reference-governance or language-fast coverage for supported source behavior.
Documentation/report evidence describing the feature and trust caveat.

features.title: Nat.add and infix +
features.checkedStory: Infix + lowers to the checked bootstrap declaration Nat.add before backend/runtime execution.

features.title: Nat.mul and infix *
features.checkedStory: Infix * lowers to the checked bootstrap declaration Nat.mul before backend/runtime execution.

features.title: Nat.pred, Nat.sub, and infix -
features.checkedStory: Nat.pred and Nat.sub are checked bootstrap declarations; infix - lowers to Nat.sub before backend/runtime execution, with saturating-at-zero Nat semantics.

features.title: Nat.beq/Nat.leb/Nat.ltb and comparison sugar
features.checkedStory: Boolean comparison operators lower to checked bootstrap Nat.beq/Nat.leb/Nat.ltb before backend/runtime execution; they are not Prop-valued order relations.

features.title: Bool if, &&, and ||
syntax: if b then x else y
features.checkedStory: Boolean if/&&/|| lower through checked Bool recursor semantics before backend/runtime execution.

features.title: Bool.not, Bool.xor, and prefix !
features.checkedStory: Bool.not and Bool.xor are checked bootstrap declarations; prefix ! lowers to checked Bool.not before backend/runtime execution.

features.title: Structures, projections, updates, and structure match
syntax: match p with | Point.mk x y => ...
features.checkedStory: Source structures lower to checked single-constructor inductive forms plus generated checked projection declarations; runtime executes only emitted checked Core shapes.

features.title: Simple user inductives, constructor shorthand, and match
features.checkedStory: Simple source inductives elaborate to checked kernel inductive declarations; constructor shorthand and match lower to checked constructor/recursor use.

features.title: Core proof steps rfl/exact/intro/assumption/apply
features.checkedStory: Proof steps elaborate to explicit checked Core terms; the parser and elaborator never replace the kernel as proof authority.
features.notes: Theorems are non-executable in JS/TS output; JS/TS evidence verifies theorem skipping and artifact trust path rather than theorem execution.

features.title: Option(A), Option.none, Option.some, and exhaustive Option match
syntax: match (o) { | Option.none => noneCase | Option.some value => someCase }
features.checkedStory: Option is a checked bootstrap inductive. Constructor type parameters are explicit in PSC-1 source and erased by backend emission only after Core checking. Exhaustive Option matches elaborate to checked non-indexed recursor applications.
features.notes: P5.6 intentionally supports explicit erased constructor type arguments, e.g. Option.none(Nat) and Option.some(Nat, value). Generic constructor shorthand none/some is deferred.

features.title: List(Nat), List.nil, List.cons, exhaustive List match, and bounded structural recursion
syntax: match (xs) { | List.nil => nilCase | List.cons head tail => consCase }
features.checkedStory: List is a checked bootstrap inductive. Constructor type parameters are explicit in PSC-1 source and erased by backend emission only after Core checking. Exhaustive List(Nat) matches elaborate to checked non-indexed recursor applications; bounded direct structural recursion over List(Nat) reuses the existing recursive-field recursor path.
features.notes: P5.7 intentionally supports explicit erased constructor type arguments, e.g. List.nil(Nat) and List.cons(Nat, head, tail). Generic shorthand [] / :: and polymorphic List library functions are deferred.

features.title: String type and checked string literals
features.checkedStory: String literals are parsed as source string literals, elaborated to explicit Core lit.str terms, checked by the trusted K3-TB kernel as String only after String is present in the checked bootstrap, and emitted to JS/TypeScript only after Core checking. This is a bounded literal/type/execution slice, not the full Lean String API.
features.notes: P5.8 intentionally supports only checked String literals and simple String values/functions through JS/TS emission. String pattern matching, Unicode APIs, concatenation/library functions, Lean String internals, and full String semantics remain deferred.

features.title: Int type, checked literals, bounded primitive arithmetic, and operator foundation
features.checkedStory: Integer literals are parsed as source int/numeric literals, elaborated to explicit Core lit.int terms when the expected type is Int, checked by the trusted K3-TB kernel as Int only after Int is present in the checked bootstrap, and emitted to JS/TypeScript as BigInt only after Core checking. P5.10 adds checked Int.neg/Int.add/Int.sub/Int.beq declarations plus bounded trusted-kernel reduction only when arguments reduce to explicit Core Int literals; general Int terms remain stuck.
features.notes: P5.11 adds bounded type-directed +, -, and == surface operators on top of P5.10 checked Int primitive arithmetic. Int ordering, Int multiplication operator, conversion APIs, OfNat/Neg typeclass elaboration, arbitrary-precision serialized literals beyond host safe integers, and full Lean Int internals remain deferred.

features.title: Type-directed Int +, -, and == operators
features.checkedStory: P5.11 introduces an explicit surface binaryOp node so parser operators no longer prematurely hard-code Nat. The elaborator lowers +, -, and == to Nat or Int checked primitives using expected type, obvious Int syntax, and local/inferred operand types. The resulting Core still calls checked Nat.* or Int.* declarations and is type-checked/replayed by the K3-TB kernel before JS/TypeScript emission.
features.notes: This is not full Lean numeric typeclass overloading. It is a bounded PSC-1 type-directed operator lowering for Int and Nat. Int * and Int ordering remain fail-closed/deferred.

features.title: Array(Nat), Array.mk, and expected-type-directed array literals
features.checkedStory: P5.12 adds a bounded surface array literal. The parser produces SurfaceTerm.arrayLit, and the elaborator requires an expected Array(A) type before lowering each element through the ordinary checked element type, then constructing checked Core Array.mk(A, List.cons(... List.nil(A))). The K3-TB kernel rechecks Array, List, constructor applications, and rfl equality before JS/TypeScript emission. No backend/runtime shortcut can create an array without checked Core.
features.notes: This is not the full Lean Array API. P5.12 supports expected-type-directed Array(Nat) literal construction over the checked List payload representation. Array indexing, push/pop, size, mutation, ForIn, and full persistent-array semantics remain deferred.

features.title: Except(E, A), explicit constructors, and exhaustive Except(String, Nat) match
syntax: match (result) { | Except.error message => 0 | Except.ok value => value }
features.checkedStory: P5.13 adds a bounded Result-style Except feature through the existing checked inductive path. The checked bootstrap declares Except(E, A) with explicit Except.error(E, A, error) and Except.ok(E, A, value) constructors. Source constructor calls and exhaustive matches elaborate to checked Core constructor/recursor applications, then the K3-TB kernel rechecks them before JS/TypeScript tagged-record emission. No backend/runtime shortcut can construct or inspect Except without checked Core.
features.notes: This is not the full Lean Except API and not JavaScript exception semantics. P5.13 supports explicit checked constructors plus exhaustive matches for Except(String, Nat) smoke, reusing the existing non-indexed inductive recursor path.

features.title: Array.size and Array.get? over checked Array(A) literals
syntax: theorem first_rfl: first = Option.some(Nat, 1) := by rfl
features.checkedStory: P5.14 adds bounded Array.size and Array.get? through checked bootstrap declarations plus trusted K3-TB reduction only for checked Array.mk values backed by finite List payloads. The parser accepts Lean-style ? identifier tails, the elaborator emits ordinary checked Core applications, the kernel rechecks the Array/Option/Nat types before reduction, and JS/TypeScript emission erases only the type argument after Core checking. No backend/runtime shortcut can inspect an unchecked array.
features.notes: This is not the full Lean Array API. P5.14 supports size/get? only for checked Array.mk values whose payload is a finite checked List. Mutation, push/pop, get with proof bounds, ForIn, and full persistent-array semantics remain deferred.

features.title: Option.map and Except.map over checked constructor values
syntax: Except.map(String, Nat, Nat, inc, Except.ok(String, Nat, 4))
Except.map(String, Nat, Nat, inc, Except.error(String, Nat, "bad"))
features.checkedStory: P5.15 adds bounded Option.map and Except.map through checked bootstrap declarations plus trusted K3-TB reduction only for checked Option/Except constructor values and already-checked mapping functions. The parser uses existing application syntax, the elaborator emits ordinary checked Core applications, the kernel rechecks function and constructor types before reduction, and JS/TypeScript emission calls runtime helpers only after Core checking.
features.notes: This is not full Functor/Monad/typeclass support. P5.15 supports explicit Option.map and Except.map calls over checked constructor values with explicit type arguments and checked mapper functions. Option.bind, Except.bind, do-notation, and inferred typeclass operators remain deferred.

features.title: Option.bind and Except.bind over checked constructor values
syntax: Except.bind(String, Nat, Nat, Except.ok(String, Nat, 4), okSucc)
Except.bind(String, Nat, Nat, Except.error(String, Nat, "bad"), okSucc)
features.checkedStory: P5.16 adds bounded explicit Option.bind and Except.bind through checked bootstrap declarations plus trusted K3-TB reduction only for checked Option/Except constructor values and already-checked binding functions. The parser uses existing application syntax, the elaborator emits ordinary checked Core applications, the kernel rechecks function and constructor types before reduction, and JS/TypeScript emission calls runtime helpers only after Core checking. This is explicit call support only, not inferred Monad/typeclass or do-notation support.
features.notes: This is not full Monad/typeclass/do-notation support. P5.16 supports explicit checked Option.bind and Except.bind calls over checked constructor values with explicit type arguments and checked binder functions. Inferred bind syntax, do-notation, and full Lean library semantics remain deferred.

features.title: Minimal do-notation over checked Option.bind and Except.bind
syntax: do { x <- Except.ok(String, Nat, 4); Except.ok(String, Nat, x + 1) }
features.checkedStory: P5.17 adds minimal explicit do-notation as parser/elaborator sugar over already checked Option.bind and Except.bind. The parser creates a do-block surface term, the elaborator requires an expected Option(A) or Except(E, A) result type, infers each bound value as checked Option/Except Core, then lowers each bind to ordinary checked Core applications of Option.bind or Except.bind with a kernel-checked lambda body. JS/TypeScript emission only sees the checked bind Core and routes through the existing runtime helpers.
features.notes: This is not full Lean do-notation, Monad typeclass elaboration, IO, let/do/match statement support, do-return syntax, or inferred bind syntax. P5.17 supports only explicit monadic bind statements over expected Option/Except results and lowers to checked bind calls.

features.title: Array.map over checked finite Array payloads
features.checkedStory: P5.18 adds explicit Array.map through a checked bootstrap declaration plus bounded K3-TB primitive reduction. The kernel first validates the full constant application, then reduces only checked Array.mk(A, finite List(A)) payloads by applying the already-checked function to each element and rebuilding Array.mk(B, List...). JS/TypeScript emission calls a runtime helper only after Core checking.
features.notes: This is not full Lean Array/Functor/typeclass support, mapM, mutation, push/pop, fold, or complete collection semantics. P5.18 supports explicit checked Array.map calls only over finite checked Array.mk/List payloads.

features.checkedStory: P5.19 adds explicit List.map through a checked bootstrap declaration plus bounded K3-TB primitive reduction. The kernel first validates the full constant application, then reduces only checked finite List(A) constructor payloads by applying the already-checked function to each element and rebuilding List(B). JS/TypeScript emission calls a runtime helper only after Core checking.
features.notes: This is not full Lean List/Functor/typeclass support, append/fold/filter, or complete collection semantics. P5.19 supports explicit checked List.map calls only over finite checked List constructor payloads.

JS/TypeScript emission calls a runtime helper only after Core checking.

JS/TypeScript emission calls runtime helpers only after Core checking.
features.notes: This is not full Lean List/Array/Foldable/Filterable/typeclass support. P5.22 supports explicit checked filter calls only over finite checked List constructor payloads and Array.mk/List payloads.

JS/TypeScript emission calls runtime helpers only after Core checking.

The kernel validates the full constant application first, reads only finite checked List constructor payloads or Array.mk/List payloads with matching element type, returns a checked Nat literal length or Bool empty result, and JS/TypeScript emission calls runtime helpers only after Core checking.
features.notes: This is not full Lean List.length/Array.isEmpty/library/typeclass support. P5.24 supports explicit checked calls only over finite checked List constructor payloads and Array.mk/List payloads.

features.checkedStory: P5.25 adds explicit List.reverse and Array.reverse through checked bootstrap declarations plus bounded K3-TB primitive reduction. The kernel validates the full constant application first, reads only finite checked List constructor payloads or Array.mk/List payloads with matching element type, reverses the payload order, then rebuilds checked List(A) or Array(A) Core values. JS/TypeScript emission calls runtime helpers only after Core checking.

features.title: List.any/List.all and Array.any/Array.all over checked finite payloads
features.checkedStory: P5.26 adds explicit List.any/List.all and Array.any/Array.all through checked bootstrap declarations plus bounded K3-TB primitive reduction. The kernel validates the full constant application first, reads only finite checked List constructor payloads or Array.mk/List payloads with matching element type, evaluates the checked predicate to Bool for each element, returns Lean-compatible empty cases (any=false, all=true), and emits JS/TypeScript runtime helpers only after Core checking.
features.notes: This is not full Lean List.any/List.all/Array.any/Array.all/library/typeclass support. P5.26 supports explicit checked calls only over finite checked List constructor payloads and Array.mk/List payloads with predicates that reduce to Bool.

features.checkedStory: P5.28 adds explicit List.find? and Array.find? through checked bootstrap declarations plus bounded K3-TB primitive reduction. The kernel validates the full constant application first, reads only finite checked List constructor payloads or Array.mk/List payloads with matching element type, evaluates the checked predicate to Bool for each element, returns Option.some(A, firstMatchingValue) or Option.none(A), and emits JS/TypeScript runtime helpers only after Core checking.
features.notes: This is not full Lean List.find?/Array.find?/library/typeclass support. P5.28 supports explicit checked calls only over finite checked List constructor payloads and Array.mk/List payloads with predicates that reduce to Bool.

features.checkedStory: P5.29 adds explicit List.head? and Array.head? through checked bootstrap declarations plus bounded K3-TB primitive reduction. The kernel validates the full constant application first, reads only finite checked List constructor payloads or Array.mk/List payloads with matching element type, returns Option.some(A, firstValue) for non-empty payloads and Option.none(A) for empty payloads, and emits JS/TypeScript runtime helpers only after Core checking.
features.notes: This is not full Lean List.head?/Array.head?/library/typeclass support. P5.29 supports explicit checked calls only over finite checked List constructor payloads and Array.mk/List payloads.

features.checkedStory: P5.30 adds explicit List.tail? and Array.tail? through checked bootstrap declarations plus bounded K3-TB primitive reduction. The kernel validates the full constant application first, reads only finite checked List constructor payloads or Array.mk/List payloads with matching element type, returns Option.some(List(A), tailList) or Option.some(Array(A), tailArray) for non-empty payloads, and returns Option.none(List(A)) / Option.none(Array(A)) for empty payloads. JS/TypeScript runtime helpers are used only after Core checking.
features.notes: This is not full Lean List.tail?/Array.tail?/library/typeclass support. P5.30 supports explicit checked calls only over finite checked List constructor payloads and Array.mk/List payloads.

features.title: List.isEmpty over checked finite payloads
features.checkedStory: P5.31 adds explicit List.isEmpty through a checked bootstrap declaration plus bounded K3-TB primitive reduction. The kernel validates the full constant application first, reads only finite checked List constructor payloads with matching element type, returns true for List.nil and false for List.cons payloads, and JS/TypeScript runtime helpers are used only after Core checking.
features.notes: This is not full Lean List.isEmpty/library/typeclass support. P5.31 supports explicit checked calls only over finite checked List constructor payloads.

features.checkedStory: P5.32 adds explicit List.last? and Array.last? through checked bootstrap declarations plus bounded K3-TB primitive reduction. The kernel validates the full constant application first, reads only finite checked List constructor payloads or Array.mk/List payloads with matching element type, returns Option.some(A, lastValue) for non-empty payloads and Option.none(A) for empty payloads, and JS/TypeScript runtime helpers are used only after Core checking.
features.notes: This is not full Lean List.last?/Array.back?/Array.getLast?/library/typeclass support. P5.32 supports explicit checked calls only over finite checked List constructor payloads and Array.mk/List payloads.

features.title: List.get? over checked finite List payloads
features.checkedStory: P5.33 adds explicit List.get? through a checked bootstrap declaration plus bounded K3-TB primitive reduction. The kernel validates the full constant application first, reads only finite checked List constructor payloads with matching element type, requires the index to type-check as Nat, returns Option.some(A, valueAtIndex) for in-bounds indices and Option.none(A) for out-of-bounds or empty payloads, and JS/TypeScript runtime helpers are used only after Core checking.
features.notes: This is not full Lean List.get?/Fin-indexed get/library/typeclass support. P5.33 supports explicit checked calls only over finite checked List constructor payloads and Nat indices.

features.title: List.take and Array.take over checked finite payloads
features.checkedStory: P5.34 adds explicit List.take and Array.take through checked bootstrap declarations plus bounded K3-TB primitive reduction. The kernel validates the full constant application first, reads only finite checked List constructor payloads or Array.mk/List payloads with matching element type, requires the count to type-check as Nat, returns the checked prefix collection clamped to payload length, and JS/TypeScript runtime helpers are used only after Core checking.
features.notes: This is not full Lean List.take/Array slice/library/typeclass support. P5.34 supports explicit checked calls only over finite checked List constructor payloads and Array.mk/List payloads with Nat counts.

features.title: List.drop and Array.drop over checked finite payloads
features.checkedStory: P5.35 adds explicit List.drop and Array.drop through checked bootstrap declarations plus bounded K3-TB primitive reduction. The kernel validates the full constant application first, reads only finite checked List constructor payloads or Array.mk/List payloads with matching element type, requires the count to type-check as Nat, returns the checked suffix collection with the count clamped to payload length, and JS/TypeScript runtime helpers are used only after Core checking.
features.notes: This is not full Lean List.drop/Array slice/library/typeclass support. P5.35 supports explicit checked calls only over finite checked List constructor payloads and Array.mk/List payloads with Nat counts.

features.title: List.range and Array.range over checked Nat counts
features.checkedStory: P5.36 adds explicit List.range and Array.range through checked bootstrap declarations plus bounded K3-TB primitive reduction. The kernel validates the full constant application first, requires the count to type-check as Nat, constructs finite checked List(Nat) payloads containing 0 through count-1, wraps Array.range results in checked Array.mk(Nat, data), bounds reduction to the existing finite payload limit, and JS/TypeScript runtime helpers are used only after Core checking.
features.notes: This is not full Lean List.range / Array.range library/typeclass support. P5.36 supports explicit checked calls only over Nat counts that can be reduced inside the bounded PSC-1 finite payload limit.

features.title: List.replicate and Array.replicate over checked Nat counts and values
features.checkedStory: P5.37 adds explicit List.replicate and Array.replicate through checked bootstrap declarations plus bounded K3-TB primitive reduction. The kernel validates the full constant application first, requires the count to type-check as Nat and the value to type-check as A, constructs finite checked payloads containing repeated copies of the checked value, wraps Array.replicate results in checked Array.mk(A, data), bounds reduction to the existing finite payload limit, and JS/TypeScript runtime helpers are used only after Core checking.
features.notes: Promoted in P5.37 as a compact checked-Core-first finite collection constructor helper; this is not full Lean collection/typeclass/library support.

features.title: List.toArray and Array.toList conversions over checked finite payloads
features.checkedStory: P5.38 adds explicit List.toArray and Array.toList through checked bootstrap declarations plus bounded K3-TB primitive reduction. The kernel validates the full constant application first, requires the input to type-check as List(A) or Array(A), reads finite checked constructor payloads, rebuilds canonical Array.mk(A, data) or List(A) payloads, and JS/TypeScript runtime helpers are used only after Core checking.
features.notes: Promoted in P5.38 as a compact checked-Core-first finite collection conversion helper; this is not full Lean collection/typeclass/library support.

features.title: List.takeWhile and Array.takeWhile over checked finite payloads
features.checkedStory: P5.39 adds explicit List.takeWhile and Array.takeWhile through checked bootstrap declarations plus bounded K3-TB primitive reduction. The kernel validates the full constant application first, reads only finite checked List constructor payloads or Array.mk/List payloads with matching element type, requires the predicate to type-check as A -> Bool, keeps the checked prefix until the first false predicate result, and JS/TypeScript runtime helpers are used only after Core checking.
features.notes: This is not full Lean List.takeWhile/Array library/typeclass support. P5.39 supports explicit checked calls only over finite checked List constructor payloads and Array.mk/List payloads with predicates returning Bool.

features.title: List.dropWhile and Array.dropWhile over checked finite payloads
features.checkedStory: P5.40 adds explicit List.dropWhile and Array.dropWhile through checked bootstrap declarations plus bounded K3-TB primitive reduction. The kernel validates the full constant application first, reads only finite checked List constructor payloads or Array.mk/List payloads with matching element type, requires the predicate to type-check as A -> Bool, drops the checked prefix while the predicate returns true, then rebuilds the remaining suffix. JS/TypeScript runtime helpers are used only after Core checking.
features.notes: This is not full Lean List.dropWhile/Array library/typeclass support. P5.40 supports explicit checked calls only over finite checked List constructor payloads and Array.mk/List payloads with predicates returning Bool.

features.checkedStory: P5.41 adds explicit List.countP and Array.countP through checked bootstrap declarations plus bounded K3-TB primitive reduction. JS/TypeScript runtime helpers are used only after Core checking.
features.notes: This is not full Lean List.countP/Array library/typeclass support. P5.41 supports explicit checked calls only over finite checked List constructor payloads and Array.mk/List payloads with predicates returning Bool.

features.title: List.singleton and Array.singleton checked-bootstrap finite payload constructors
features.checkedStory: P5.42 adds List.singleton and Array.singleton as checked bootstrap definitions, not as new kernel primitives. The bootstrap definitions are independently Core-checked: List.singleton expands to List.cons(A, value, List.nil(A)); Array.singleton expands to Array.mk(A, List.singleton(A, value)). JS/TypeScript emission routes checked Core calls to small runtime helpers only after Core checking. No kernel refactor, restructuring, or new primitive reduction rule is introduced.
features.notes: P5.42 supports explicit checked singleton constructors for finite List/Array payloads. This is checked-bootstrap PSC-1 support, not full Lean collection/typeclass/library equivalence and not a kernel refactor.

features.notes: P5.44 supports explicit checked Option.getD and Except.getD default extraction helpers. This is checked-bootstrap PSC-1 support, not full Lean library/typeclass equivalence and not a kernel refactor.

JS/TypeScript emission routes checked Core calls to small runtime helpers only after Core checking. No kernel refactor, restructuring, source change, or new primitive reduction rule is introduced.
features.notes: P5.47 supports explicit checked Option/Except collection conversion helpers. This is checked-bootstrap PSC-1 support, not full Lean library/typeclass equivalence and not a kernel refactor.

features.title: Option.toExcept / Except.toArray checked-bootstrap conversion helpers
features.checkedStory: P5.48 adds Option.toExcept and Except.toArray as checked bootstrap definitions over existing Option.rec, Except.toOption, and Option.toArray.
